title: Detail-page 'VIEWING HELD' pill has no pin; suite stays green if it reverts to 'VIEWED'
evidence:
client/src/pages/application_detail.gleam:566:    application.Viewed -> #("bg-navy/10 text-navy", "VIEWING HELD")
client/test/client_test.gleam:2276 (test_application fixture, the only fixture used by the detail-page tests):    status: application.Submitted,
client/test/client_test.gleam:2508-2509 (added by this diff):  html |> string.contains(">Viewed<") |> should.be_false
  html |> string.contains(">VIEWED<") |> should.be_false
grep -rn "VIEWING HELD" client/ matches only client/src/pages/application_detail.gleam:566 and client/build/dev/javascript/client/pages/application_detail.mjs:413 — zero matches under client/test/ (checked client_test.gleam, components/, pages/).
detail: Every detail-page test uses a Submitted fixture, so the Viewed pill arm never renders and the '>VIEWED<' absent pin is vacuous for it; reverting line 566 to 'VIEWED' passes all 574 green tests, silently breaking the #613 one-term contract.
recommended_fix: Add one test rendering application_detail_page.view with a Viewed-status application asserting 'VIEWING HELD' present and '>VIEWED<' absent, mirroring status_pill_viewed_renders_navy_test.

title: Viewed-stop title hint's is_current guard: absent-branch untested
detail: The R1-added conditional (hint omitted on the already-marked stop) pins only the present branch; nothing asserts absence when the viewed stop IS current, so that named review fix can silently regress.
recommended_fix: In the same Viewed-fixture detail test from the coverage-gap fix, assert the stepper-stop-viewed button serializes without a title attribute.
